variables.just_eat:
(?x)(?:              # ignore whitespace in this regex
  {{open}}        # start level 1                      __
    {{open}}      # start level 2      ___/ _____ \__/ /
      {{open}}    # start level 3     is like snek... (by Valerie Haecky)
        {{open}}  # start level 4
          {{nps}} #       level 4
        {{close}} #   end level 4
      {{close}}   #   end level 3
      {{open}}    # start level 3
        {{open}}  # start level 4
          {{nps}} #       level 4
        {{close}} #   end level 4
      {{close}}   #   end level 3
